integrity: The all-alphabet conclusion follows from an explicit fixed-orbit adjacency classification, a good-cover nerve collapse, a cell-attachment presentation and the simply connected Whitehead theorem. An independent finite metric-orbit and mod-two boundary checker provides additional corroboration.
limitations: Only three Hamming coordinates, one coordinate transposition and the integral persistence across the four integer scale regimes are classified. This is not an independent mathematical audit or a guarantee of absolute historical uniqueness.
title: Coordinate-transpose fixed points of three-coordinate Hamming Rips complexes
